extraction: IsoWorld little-endian header/string/property reader; native base load order then noiseworks patch, excluding unloaded legacy _4 file.

native_readings.surface: IsoObject.getSurfaceOffsetNoTable returns Surface plus render offset and ItemHeight; ISPlace3DItemCursor selects positive surfaces.
native_readings.container: IsoObject.createContainersFromSpriteProperties creates the declared container; Freezer creates the secondary freezer.
native_readings.cold_storage: ItemContainer.getTemprature checks isPowered and fridge/freezer; returns cold temperature when powered.
native_readings.attachment: HandWeapon.attachWeaponPart adds the part AimingTime to the weapon; detach subtracts it. SwipeStatePlayer ranged hit-chance calculation subtracts beenMovingFor minus (weapon AimingTime plus Aiming skill) only when positive. A positive modifier raises this threshold and can reduce the movement-related hit-chance penalty. No light-source or bayonet-stabbing route is inferred. Item parses AimingTimeModifier and copies it into WeaponPart.aimingTime; its getter is a direct field read. IsoPlayer critical-chance calculation also consumes the movement threshold, using twice the Aiming skill. Neither inspected gameplay consumer measures or shortens a separate aiming duration.
native_readings.fireplace: IsoFireplace.getTemperature returns heated temperature when lit; updateHeatSource adds IsoHeatSource.
native_readings.barbecue: IsoBarbecue creates barbecue container and supplies heated temperature when lit with fuel.
native_readings.mannequin: IsoMannequin.wearItem updates WornItems for allowed Clothing/Container body slots; inventory transfer calls wearItem on the placed mannequin.
